mentions.name: Math-expression FM synth engine
mentions.description: A music synthesizer engine written in Python and C++ that generates sound from math expressions, inspired by the Desmos graphing calculator, with an FM/DX7-style character. It runs on an M4 Mac mini with 256-voice polyphony and high expressivity via half-pedaling (sustain pedal), velocity, 8 macro knobs, no filters or FX, an ADSR envelope, and offers both a web interface and a CLI. Its math-expression concept suits sound prototyping, use as a keyboard engine, and manipulation via AI.
mentions.source_excerpt:
iI am working on a synth engine (music synthesizer) in Python and C++
not a developer; music producer, classical pianist, and occasional NI Reaktor programmer.

It creates sound from math expressions which were inspired by the Desmos graphing calculator.

The sounds are mainly of the FM/DX7 taste.
